name: Wire Electric
old_description: Wire Electric has over 20 years of experience in providing electrical solutions for all types of electrical problems. Our goal is to meet and exceed our customers satisfaction. We follow strict standards, which has led to satisfied customers in a wide variety of industries.
about:
Wire Electric is based in Jamaica, New York, and was founded in 2006. The business is described by customers as a family operation led by Gerardo and Wendy, who provide a personal touch and direct communication throughout each project.

The firm provides electrical installation, troubleshooting, and repair services for residential, commercial, and industrial clients across New York City’s five boroughs and Nassau and Suffolk counties on Long Island. It is fully licensed and insured, and emphasizes completing jobs on schedule and on budget without shortcuts. Its electricians are noted as experienced and knowledgeable, equipped to handle all facets of any job from initial contact to finished work.

Its customer base includes homeowners, businesses, and industrial facilities throughout the region. Testimonials reference projects in Bellmore, Westbury, and Baldwin, New York, illustrating the geographic reach of its service calls.

Wire Electric states that it follows strict standards to meet or exceed customer satisfaction, aiming to get the job done right the first time with results that last. The company’s stated goal is to provide high-quality service at an affordable price while standing behind its work.
